svg.text: Solid: request / process · Dashed: response · Time runs downward

g.text: Receive an allowed response, then verify trusted metadata and signatures locally. Verification failure stops
use; it never approves an artifact.
Both variants contact the source. Received content follows the configured cache/privacy policy and passes
client verification before use; unsigned or expired metadata is rejected unless explicitly excepted.
Run the HTTP refinement and compare observed actions with this sequence.
See what Squid and APT actually did for these retrieval cases.

g.text: Receive content through the tunnel and verify it at the client. No TLS interception, payload caching or
scanning. Transport or verification failure stops retrieval; detailed transport error exchanges are outside
Client TLS authenticates the source certificate and hostname end to end. The proxy neither inspects nor
caches decrypted payload; client content verification succeeds before use.
Run the HTTP refinement and compare observed actions with this sequence.
